extension.summary: AB Tools - all-in-one Kodi maintenance and skin toolkit
extension.description: ABUKARIM TOOLS is an all-in-one utility for managing your Kodi setup. It bundles a Skin Installer and Skin Switcher, full backup and restore of your userdata, and quick access to the ABUKARIM Wizard and its maintenance tools (Total Clean and old thumbnail cleanup). A built-in patcher keeps popular add-ons (Seren, Prism, TinyPPI, Arctic Fuse 3, TMDbHelper, RedLight and more) working correctly on CoreELEC and Kodi, and re-applies its fixes automatically after those add-ons update. Also includes handy maintenance tools such as a speed test, a CPU benchmark and an add-on database rebuild.
extension.summary: أدوات أبوكريم - حزمة متكاملة لصيانة كودي وإدارة الواجهات
extension.description: أدوات أبوكريم هي أداة شاملة لإدارة نظام كودي لديك. تجمع بين مثبّت الواجهات ومبدّل الواجهات، والنسخ الاحتياطي الكامل لبيانات المستخدم واستعادتها، ووصولاً سريعاً إلى معالج أبوكريم وأدوات الصيانة فيه (التنظيف الشامل وحذف الصور المصغّرة القديمة). كما تتضمّن أداة ترقيع مدمجة تُبقي الإضافات الشائعة (Seren وTinyPPI وArctic Fuse 3 وTMDbHelper وRedLight وغيرها) تعمل بشكل صحيح على CoreELEC وكودي، وتعيد تطبيق إصلاحاتها تلقائياً بعد تحديث تلك الإضافات. وتشمل أيضاً أدوات صيانة مفيدة مثل اختبار السرعة واختبار أداء المعالج وإعادة بناء قاعدة بيانات الإضافات.
extension.news: v4.5.2 - FIX: POV failed in Search All (and could fail on its own) for titles opened before in the same session - a POV cache bug, now patched. FIX: Umbrella found nothing for some titles with Kodi in Arabic - it now searches with the English title. v4.5.1 - FIX: Search All - POV often showed "Failed": some scraper results reach POV with a size or info field of the wrong type and POV's sorting gave up on the whole list; they are now cleaned and sorted again. v4.5.0 - NEW Search All: Red Light, Fen Light, Umbrella and POV search together and their streams show in one Glass list (pick "AB Search All" in TMDbHelper), with add-on / quality chips and a filter menu. NEW Glass Theme for the source windows of all four add-ons (Toggles > Glass Theme). v3.4.50 - Search All: filter menu - RIGHT on the list (or the Filter chip) filters by service, size, source site, title words and info (HDR, DV, Atmos ...) with counts; filters stack on top of the add-on / quality chips, BACK clears them. FIX: no focus error when the window opens. v3.4.49 - Search All now also searches Umbrella (UM) and POV, next to Red Light and Fen Light: four add-ons, one list. Umbrella searches with no window while you browse the list.
